desc.en: GraphComment is a comments platform that helps you build an active community from the website’s audience.
desc.zh: GraphComment 是一个评论平台，帮助你从网站受众中建立活跃社区。

desc.en: A feature-rich comment system for WordPress, Tumblr, Blogger, and many other website platforms.
desc.zh: 功能丰富的评论系统，适用于 WordPress、Tumblr、Blogger 和许多其他网站平台。

desc.en: Open source hosted comments platform, pay what you can for "One moderator on a few domains with complete control over behavior & appearance"
desc.zh: 开源的托管评论平台，"在少数域名上设置一名管理员，完全控制行为与外观"可随心付费。

desc.en: A lightweight comments widget built on GitHub issues. Use GitHub issues for blog comments, wiki pages, and more!
desc.zh: 基于 GitHub issues 构建的轻量评论小部件。使用 GitHub issues 作为博客评论、Wiki 页面等！
